{{Top|leg}}
'''Darknon Control''' was the large tower projecting out from [[Darknon Station]]. At the height of the station's operational history, Darknon Control processed a bustling hub of activity. But the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Darknon Control was all but abandoned, and was the home of Darknon Station's controller, [[Rexis Lovech]].
